# SerpScale

> SerpScale is an all-in-one SEO platform — a daily rank tracker, technical site audit tool, backlink checker and keyword research tool in one dashboard. It's an affordable, faster SEMrush and Ahrefs alternative built for agencies and in-house teams, with white-label reporting, client portals and an AI SEO copilot. Plans start at $5/mo with a free trial.

## SEO Tools
- [Keyword Rank Tracker](https://serpscale.com/rank-tracker): Track daily keyword positions on Google across desktop, mobile and location. Local and enterprise rank tracking with visibility trends, rank deltas and Google Search Console sync.
- [Keyword Research Tool](https://serpscale.com/keyword-research): Turn one seed keyword into thousands of ideas with real search volume, keyword difficulty and search intent. Free keyword finder for SEO.
- [Backlink Checker](https://serpscale.com/backlink-checker): Check backlinks and referring domains for any site, flag toxic links, and run competitor backlink gap analysis.
- [Site Audit Tool](https://serpscale.com/site-audit): Crawl every page, score site health, check Core Web Vitals and get a prioritized technical SEO audit report. Free website SEO checker.
- [Features](https://serpscale.com/features): The full toolkit — rank tracker, site audit, backlink checker, keyword research, competitor analysis, AI content writer, AI visibility tracking, AI SEO copilot, white-label reports, team roles and Google integrations.

## Pricing & Comparison
- [Pricing](https://serpscale.com/pricing): Simple, transparent SEO software pricing from $5/mo. Pick your keyword volume and scale — free trial, no card required to start.
- [SEMrush Alternative](https://serpscale.com/semrush-alternative): How SerpScale compares to SEMrush and Ahrefs — the same core SEO tools at a lower price. The best affordable SEMrush alternative.
